gauntlet: question
Which filter policy should the report view apply on a workspace switch? The workspace-change handler in `ui/report-view.ts` currently keeps active filters, and `settings/resolver.ts:12` would own the chosen default.
A) clear all filters on every workspace switch
B) preserve all active filters across switches
C) restore each workspace's last filters
Recommendation: B - it matches the handler's current behavior, so existing users see no change, and it needs no new per-workspace filter state.
